title: Independent reading: 1 Corinthians 13:1–13
subtitle: Follow conditional openings, repeated negatives, and a final triad.
overview: 1 Corinthians 13 uses repeated ἐάν constructions and a series of defining statements. Repetition makes its argument readable even when individual vocabulary is challenging.
Track the final contrast between partial and complete before reading the concluding triad.

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη μακροθυμεῖ, χρηστεύεται ἡ ἀγάπη.
items.en: Love is patient; love is kind.

items.grc: νυνὶ δὲ μένει πίστις, ἐλπίς, ἀγάπη, τὰ τρία ταῦτα.
items.en: But now faith, hope, and love remain, these three.
